messages:
anya: FYI opened PR #4123 to add a short 'Cost & SLO guidance' doc + dashboard embed. Need metric-name sanity check and a quick look at the tracehook example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :eyes:

mike: Thanks — looks like a good start. Which metric do you show for p95? we have both metricsv2 `inference.latency_p95_ms` and legacy `latency_95_pct`.

anya: Using metricsv2 `inference.latency_p95_ms` in examples. I added a fallback paragraph for `latency_95_pct` for older Dedicated installs.

kevin (SRE): Please ensure the dashboard query pattern is robust for our Prometheus/metricsv2 mix. Prefer `avg_over_time` for UX, avoid `increase()` in panel queries. Quick snippet I pasted for the embed: 
```
{"panel": {"type": "timeseries", "datasource": "redwood-metrics", "expr": "avg_over_time(inference.latency_p95_ms[5m])"}}
```

olivia: small preview bug: embed JSON in the PR missed `datasource` at top-level so the local preview complained. I pushed a tiny patch to the branch to set `datasource: redwood-metrics`.

anya: thanks @olivia — saw the patch and merged it into the PR branch. I also dropped a tiny Node tracehook snippet for users who want to attach traces to requests, can someone sanity-check?
```
// node trace hook example (minimal)
// install: npm i @redwood/tracehook
const { Tracer } = require('@redwood/tracehook');
Tracer.attach({ serviceName: 'my-api' });
```

mike: That looks fine. Suggest adding the single-line `npm i` line above the snippet so readers can copy-paste. Also maybe include a Python example later.

docs-bot: PR 4123 updated by olivia — CI passed :white_check_mark:  (build/markdown-lint)

kevin (SRE): One more question on the cost attribution writeup: are we recommending token-level cost per-route in the primary doc? That could be very high-cardinality and noisy for dashboards. I proposed a note recommending 24h rollups + 1% sampling for detailed views.

anya: Good call, @kevin (SRE). I added a "practicality" section: sample for token-level traces, aggregate for billing. Included an example of computing 24h rolling cost per route using the dashboard query.

olivia: I'll do a final pass on wording and add a callout distinguishing metric names between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private (some installs still expose legacy names).

mike: LGTM from docs review. Do you want me to merge once olivia finishes her pass? :shipit: 

anya: Please wait ~1 hour for Olivia to finish. If no further changes after that, go ahead and merge. Thanks all! :pray:
